outline: This course contains labs with source codes and step-by-step instructions. The  course adopts problem based lerning, concentrating on the necessary background on these machine learning labs. The content includes introduction and computer tools, DNN with labs,  learning methods with labs, CNN with labs, autoencoder with labs, and latest self attention/transformer case study Video Chaptering appliable to Youtube.
schedule:
Week 1: Machine learning introduction and computer tools,
Deep Neural Networks (DNN)with Labs
Week 2: Learning methods with Labs
Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Labs
Autoencoder with Labs
Week 3:Self attention/transformer case study Video Chaptering
Lab report (one group of 3-4 students reports one lab)
assessment: Lab report (one group report one lab)
